name: lru-cache
description: Least-Recently-Used (LRU) Cache supporting maximum capacity limit eviction and Time-To-Live expiration.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when building memory caches for heavy database reads, API response caches, user session memory pools, or image buffering frameworks. Import using: import { LruCache } from './ds/lru-cache.js';

parameters.name: capacity
parameters.description: Maximum number of items allowed in the cache before eviction.

parameters.name: ttl
parameters.description: Item lifetime in milliseconds. 0 represents infinite lifespan.
